Appraisal_Rationale: Ten naval personnel completed simulated settings; small sample and indirect workload/readiness measures constrain inference.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Simulation fidelity can be evaluated with workload and situation-awareness measures.
Evidence_Result: N=10; NASA-TLX workload did not differ significantly between simulation settings.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not establish combat-readiness improvement from simulation fidelity.

Appraisal_Rationale: Validated screening tools in 150 returning soldiers, but single male unit and simultaneous measures prevent causal claims.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Post-deployment mental-health and alcohol screening can identify concurrent readiness-relevant burden.
Evidence_Result: Among 150 UPDF soldiers, 24 screened positive for PTSD (16%); results are screening data, not clinical diagnosis or causal effects.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not establish alcohol or PTSD causes reduced combat readiness.

Appraisal_Rationale: Small wellness-program sample and self-reported diet constrain precision and generalizability.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Dietary patterns and cardiovascular-risk measures can be jointly assessed in firefighter wellness programs.
Evidence_Result: Career firefighters completed dietary and health assessments; observational associations do not determine dietary causation.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not show that diet modification changes cardiovascular risk or readiness.

Appraisal_Rationale: Only 14 volunteer soldiers with no control group; short detraining period and age strata are imprecise.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Short training interruption can be monitored with cardiorespiratory and strength measures.
Evidence_Result: Four weeks of detraining did not significantly alter several anthropometric or isometric-strength outcomes in this small sample.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not quantify a general detraining effect or justify readiness policy.

Appraisal_Rationale: Strategic framework without reproducible methods or empirical results.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Nutrition can be considered across prepare-perform-recover phases of military capability.
Evidence_Result: Framework article provides no study-level effect estimate.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not demonstrate that capability framing improves readiness.

Appraisal_Rationale: CFIR-guided interviews include clinicians, managers and police, but post-hoc design and unknown police denominator limit representation.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: CFIR can structure reported barriers and enablers for police mental-health co-responder implementation.
Evidence_Result: Interviews included six clinicians, two clinical managers, 15 police officers and seven station leaders; effectiveness was not evaluated.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not establish program effectiveness or transferability to Brazil.

Appraisal_Rationale: Ten leader interviews capture implementation perceptions but neither clinician outcomes nor user-level effectiveness.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Leaders identified organizational implementation considerations for therapist-guided ICBT for public-safety personnel.
Evidence_Result: N=10 organizational leaders discussed reach, adoption and implementation perceptions under RE-AIM.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not show that ICBT improves symptoms, use, or operational readiness.

Appraisal_Rationale: Search was described but retained source provides no reproducible synthesis results or risk-of-bias assessment.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Body-composition standards may have performance and health trade-offs requiring cautious assessment.
Evidence_Result: Review scope addresses body composition, performance and health but no extractable pooled effect was reported.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not establish a body-composition threshold or causal readiness effect.

Appraisal_Rationale: Occupational CPET records support within-person comparison, but COVID exposure and timing are partly self-reported and no uninfected comparator is described.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Mild-to-moderate COVID-19 may be followed with occupational cardiorespiratory testing in firefighters.
Evidence_Result: Records identified 152 reported infections; two hospitalization cases were excluded, so findings apply only to the retained mild-to-moderate cohort.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not establish COVID-19 caused changes in all firefighters or set return-to-duty thresholds.

Appraisal_Rationale: Phase III non-inferiority trial protocol with no participant outcomes.
Integrity_Rationale: No editorial notice identified in source reviewed.
Claim_Current_Wording: Group suicide-prevention therapies are being compared in military service members.
Evidence_Result: Protocol describes a planned two-arm randomized comparison and no efficacy results.
Prohibited_Inference: Does not demonstrate suicide-prevention or readiness effects.
